question: Will John Shulli be the Republican nominee for Senate in Delaware?
rules:
This market will resolve according to the winner of the Republican Primary for United States Senator from Delaware.

If no 2026 Delaware Republican Senate Primary takes place, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be the first announcement of the results from the Delaware Republican party, however an overwhelming consensus of credible reporting may suffice.

evidence.publisher: Delaware Department of Elections / State of Delaware News
evidence.excerpt: The Delaware Department of Elections issued a voting alert notifying eligible primary voters that early voting for the 2026 primary election starts September 2. The primary election is scheduled for September 15, 2026.

evidence.publisher: Delaware Department of Elections / State of Delaware News
evidence.excerpt: Voters automatically registered without a political party affiliation at the DMV by the August 22 primary registration deadline may designate their affiliation as Democratic or Republican up to and including September 15, 2026. These voters may choose a Democratic or Republican primary ballot when voting at an early voting site or their assigned polling place.

Former state senator and physician Mike Katz and military veteran John Shulli are vying to be the GOP nominee in Delaware’s 2026 primary for U.S. Senate. Katz’s endorsements include the Delaware Republican Party, Northern New Castle County Republicans, former U.S. Attorney Julianne Murray and several state legislators. Shulli has endorsements from state Rep. Lyndon Yearick and former National Security Advisor Michael Flynn.

The Sussex County Republican Party endorsed Dr. Mike Katz for the United States Senate and encouraged Republicans across Sussex County to support him in the September 15 Republican primary. The announcement states that Katz had earned the support of 82 percent of delegates at the 2026 Delaware Republican State Convention.

evidence.publisher: Katz for Delaware — campaign press release
evidence.excerpt: The Northern New Castle County Republican Party announced its endorsement of Dr. Mike Katz for the United States Senate. The organization called on registered Republicans across New Castle County to vote for Katz in the September 15 primary.

In the convention’s only contested race, physician and former state senator Mike Katz defeated retired Army Col. John Schulli for the U.S. Senate endorsement. Katz received 233 delegate votes to Shulli’s 52, approximately 81.7 percent of delegate support.

evidence.publisher: Federal Election Commission — John Shulli Statement of Candidacy
evidence.excerpt: John Shulli’s Statement of Candidacy identifies the office sought as Senate, the state as Delaware and the party as Republican. The filing designates Shulli for Senate as his principal campaign committee and is dated January 15, 2026.
